preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0].split()) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= int(line.split()[1]) <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input must contain valid integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 10^5), followed by m lines each with li, ri, qi where 1 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ n and 0 ≤ qi < 2^30.
Input must have exactly m + 1 lines: first line with n and m, followed by m constraint lines.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and all(0 <= int(x) < 2**30 for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is exactly 'NO'. If a solution exists, output is 'YES' followed by a line of n integers (0 ≤ a[i] < 2^30).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all((int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[i-1]) & int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[j-1])) == int(q) for i, j, q in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1]), int(line.split()[2])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if (i <= k <= j for k in range(1, n+1))))
postconditions.description: If output is 'YES', the array a must satisfy all constraints: for each constraint (li, ri, qi), the bitwise AND of all a[k] for k in [li, ri] must equal qi.
If output is 'YES', the array must have exactly n elements.
